title: Pocketwire Advance Line Applications and the Eligibility Check
content:
A Pocketwire Advance line can be applied for only by a customer whose Pocketwire Personal Account is active on Pocketwire Core or a higher plan, so the personal account's plan and status decide access to advances. This condition is read from the system record of the personal account the line is linked to — its status and its plan.

## The eligibility check

The eligibility check approves the line on Pocketwire Advance Starter when the Starter entry requirement is met, and declines it otherwise. The Starter entry requirement has two parts, both of which must hold:

1. the personal account was opened at least 60 days before the application; and
2. direct deposits into the personal account in the previous calendar month total at least 300.00.

A representative cannot approve a line or raise its starting tier.

## What an application records

- A new line is recorded as applied, on Pocketwire Advance Starter, with an outstanding balance of 0.00, no on-time repayments and no months below the direct deposit requirement.
- Its first monthly review date is the first day of the next calendar month.
- An approved line becomes active. A declined line becomes closed, with the decline date as its closing date.

## Decision table

| Personal account opened before the application | Direct deposits in the previous calendar month | Eligibility check |
|---|---|---|
| 60 days or more | 300.00 or more | Approves on Pocketwire Advance Starter |
| 60 days or more | Less than 300.00 | Declines |
| Fewer than 60 days | 300.00 or more | Declines |
| Fewer than 60 days | Less than 300.00 | Declines |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- A personal account opened exactly 60 days before the application meets the first part; one opened 59 days before does not.
- Direct deposits of exactly 300.00 in the previous calendar month meet the second part; 299.99 does not.
